SEO internal links and content intent

Internal links help users and crawlers discover relevant pages. Write helpful, original content
matching search intent; use meaningful link text and avoid keyword stuffing.
User Jහායන Jදේට ගුළJපන content ලියන්න. Related pages වලට descriptive links Jදෙන්න.
